Marina (PM): Hey team — quick design review request. We're shipping a small 'spotlight' CTA in the empty-project empty state to surface sample projects and the quickstart banner. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/spotlight-cta — want a fast pass for layout + copy + accessibility before I flag this for QA. Goal: higher activation for sample projects without blocking first-run flow.

Leo (Designer): Sharing two low-fi variants: Variant A (compact card grid, subtle pulse on primary CTA) and Variant B (horizontal carousel with larger art). Updated figma frames are annotated.

Priya (Frontend): I can implement both but need to know: preferred animation timing (ms), whether the pulse is purely CSS or Lottie, and analytics event names. Also: can we avoid heavy images for mobile?

Marina (PM): Keep it CSS-only. Animation: 600ms ease-in-out for pulse, 80ms micro-interaction for hover. Events: `onboard_spotlight_impression` and `onboard_spotlight_cta_click`. Mobile should fall back to single stacked card (no carousel).

Leo (Designer): Copy options inline — shortlist:
- Primary CTA: "Try a sample project"
- Secondary: "Browse templates"
- Helper text: "Deploy a demo in <5 minutes with one click"
My preference is the shorter primary CTA but happy to test.

Rin (A11y): A couple of accessibility nits I spotted: color token `--spotlight-primary` at #2b6df6 on white fails AA for 14px body text when used in light-weight labels. Need contrast >=4.5:1 for body text or use larger font / bold. Also ensure focus ring is 3px and has visible offset; carousel controls must be keyboard reachable. Add `aria-live="polite"` when dynamic content swaps so screen reader users aren't spammed.

Priya (Frontend): Good catches. For focus ring I can add: `:focus{outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px}`. For carousel keyboard: I'll wire arrow keys + visible focus states. For `aria-live`, question — do we announce card title on slide?

Rin (A11y): Announcing the title is fine but debounce updates — announce only when user triggers (arrow or swipe), not on auto-advance. And add a "Pause autoplay" control. Autoplay should default off on reduced-motion/any prefers-reduced-motion.

Diego (DevEx): Implementation note: sample projects list should come from existing /sample-projects API so credits and repo links match. We should also track whether a user has dismissed the spotlight so it doesn't reappear on subsequent sessions — store a small flag keyed by user-id, server-side if logged in, localStorage for anonymous flows. Also propose adding a "skip tutorial" quick link in header for power users.

Marina (PM): Agreed on server-side flag for logged-in. For anon users localStorage is fine. Keep dismissal TTL = 30 days for now. Please add metric: `onboard_spotlight_dismiss` with reason tags (x button, completed sample).

Priya (Frontend): Quick proto CSS I tried locally:```css
.spotlight-card{border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 6px 12px rgba(12,24,40,0.06);transition:transform 120ms}
.spotlight-cta.pulse{animation:spot-pulse 600ms ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes spot-pulse{0%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.03)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
```
Works well on desktop; will add `prefers-reduced-motion` override.

Leo (Designer): Small copy tweak: change helper to "Deploy a demo in minutes" — feels less prescriptive than `<5 minutes`. LGT?

Marina (PM): Good call — change to "in minutes" to avoid promise.

Rin (A11y): One more: ensure contrast for the helper text and secondary CTA meets AA; if we use muted gray, bump weight to 15/700 or increase size to 13px. Also confirm 24px touch target for CTA on mobile.

Priya (Frontend): Noted. I'll set CTA min-size 44px height and adjust helper font-weight.

Diego (DevEx): If we surface sample projects, let's add a tiny chef's-kiss badge for curated ones and an API flag `curated=true` so we can A/B surface only curated content in the spotlight experiment.

Marina (PM): Experimental plan: run 2-week A/B with variants A/B, metric: sample_project_click_rate and activation (created-first-deploy within 7 days). Diego — can you wire experiment in LaunchDarkly?

Diego (DevEx): Yep, will add flag `spotlight_variant` with values `control,A,B` and ensure analytics hook.

OnboardingBot: Experiment "spotlight-cta-2026-03" created by Marina. Flag: spotlight_variant. Audience: 10% random seed.

Leo (Designer): Final ask: copy micro-variants for testing — I'll post a tiny doc with 3 headline variants in figma comments.

Marina (PM): Thanks all — action items: Priya implement accessibility fixes + animation knobs, Rin to sign off A11y pass, Diego to set up experiment + dismissal logic, Leo to finalize queued copy, I'll schedule a quick QA pass next Tue. :thumbsup:

Priya (Frontend): On it, will ping when demo branch is up.

Rin (A11y): I'll test keyboard + screenreader once branch is ready.

Diego (DevEx): I'll create the LD flag and add analytics events by EOD.

Marina (PM): Perfect. Closing thread, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
